answer: Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, reduced by each unverified claim, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. By the horizon of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The mirror lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the gale is where a second reviewer recomputes them.
